items.title: Question 12
items.description: Question 12.1 indicates that, in addition to being the UBO, Dunja Kuljic is also the CEO, CFO and CTO. However, the business plan indicates that the CFO and the CTO are to be appointed within 60 days of license issuance. The information regarding her roles in the portal, business plan, and question 12.1 must align. If Dunja Kuljic is not the CFO and CTO, please update her roles in the portal and correct the information in question 12.1 and resubmit the form. If she is the CFO and CTO, the business plan must be updated and resubmitted.

items.title: Business Plan
items.description: The business plan states that the roles of CFO and CTO are to be appointed within 60 days of license issuance. However, the UBO's roles in the portal and on question 12.1 of the Business and Corporate Information Form indicate that she is the UBO, CEO, CFO and CTO. If the information in the business plan is no longer accurate, please update the company management structure section and resubmit the business plan.
